Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman’s Defense Systems sector is currently seeking an Technical Production Program Manager 2 to support the AARGM Program for the Advanced Weapons Business Unit located in Northridge, CA.

This position is required to be full-time, on-site in the Northridge, CA location. No remote/telework arrangement is available for this position.  

The Technical Production Program Manager 2 will lead and manage production of the Advanced Anti-Radiation Guided Missile (AARGM), an air-launched, counter-air-defense weapon system for U.S. and FMS customers.  The Production Program Manager oversees production contract execution phases including: kick-off, planning, material procurement, manufacturing, and delivery.

Responsibilities:

Lead and direct cross-functional Integrated Program Teams (IPT) to meet program cost, schedule and technical performance objectives

Manage DoD customer relationships

Measure and report program performance

Develop and brief executive level presentations to customer leadership, executive management, and other program stakeholders

Participate in the negotiation of contracts, contract changes, specifications, operating budgets, schedule milestones, and key terms and conditions

Support and at times lead the development and adherence to budget baselines utilizing Earned Value Management (EVM) or similar cost & schedule control methodologies and tools

Identify, allocate and manage program resources, including workforce planning

Coordinate with Government Property team in support of Government/customer supplied property or information (GFE, CFE, etc.)

Support the management of Intercompany Work Order (IWO) and Independent Suppliers to meet program objectives

Adhere to all internal processes, policies, and applicable industry standards

Support and at times lead the development and adherence to master plans and integrated master schedules

Conduct thorough risk & opportunity management practices including identification, mitigation and realization

Support and lead proposal preparation process as required

Attributes:

Production Management: Strong understanding of production and manufacturing processes

Business Acumen: Strong understanding of financial, market, and strategic concepts.

Capture Management: Ability to anticipate and shape customer needs.

Communication: Skilled at stakeholder engagement, conflict resolution, and executive-level reporting.

Program Growth: Experience identifying and driving business expansion.

Proposal Development: Ability to shape RFP responses and deliver compliant proposals.

Risk & Opportunity Management: Forward-looking, analytical approach to uncertainty.  Familiarity with R&O Mgmt processes.

Customer Intimacy: Builds strong, trusted relationships with customers and partners.

High Resilience: Integrity and resilience under pressure, and ability to make data-driven decisions.

Continuous Improvement: Familiarity with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of program management experience OR a master’s degree and 6 years of program management experience.

4+ years of managing production programs and leading high performing, cross-functional teams within the aerospace/defense sector

Experience leading the performance of tasks on schedule, at or under cost achieving all requirements as either a project lead, integrated program team lead, or cost account manager.

Experience with executive level power point presentations

Demonstrated competencies with risk, issues and opportunities

Management of firm fixed price (FFP) projects

Proficiency in project management tools and processes such as Earned Value Management System (EVMS), Integrated Master Schedule (IMS), and Risk and Opportunity Management.

Preferred Qualifications:

A degree in science, engineering, or business

PMP® certification

Experience managing programs as the Prime Contractor for DoD systems

Experience in continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or similar frameworks.

Current US Government Secret security clearance with ability to get cleared for SAP

We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.

Role Description

Form Energy is hiring a Process Engineering Manager to oversee our Electrode Manufacturing Operations. In this role, you will lead a team of process engineers, equipment engineers, and technicians responsible for the performance, reliability, and efficiency of our electrode production lines — spanning powder handling, mixing, and roll-to-roll tape formation processes. You'll bring strong technical judgment grounded in material science, along with a data-driven approach, to guide your team in diagnosing process issues, prioritizing improvement projects, and implementing robust, high-impact solutions on the floor. You will own staffing, coaching, and performance management for your team, while partnering with cross-functional engineering leaders to translate process and materials insights into meaningful, lasting manufacturing improvements. This is a unique opportunity to leverage your process engineering background, materials expertise, and leadership experience to build a world-class, fully automated electrode production process.

Relocation assistance is available. 

What you'll do:

Own the section's operating results across powder handling, mixing, and roll-to-roll tape formation, holding your team accountable for line cadence, downtime, and overall throughput

Manage and develop a small, mostly-engineer team of process engineers, equipment engineers, and technicians, including staffing, coaching, and performance decisions

Establish and track section-level metrics (OEE, yield, cycle time) and direct resourcing toward the highest-impact bottlenecks across each process step

Set methods and standards for evaluating and vetting floor-level solutions, ensuring fixes across the powder-to-tape process are safe, robust, and grounded in sound material science before scale-up

Represent the section in cross-functional planning with peer engineering and manufacturing teams, resolving constraints that affect quality and throughput company-wide

Build and prioritize a continuous improvement roadmap for the section, balancing waste reduction, ergonomics, and process reliability against production demands

What you'll bring:

Bachelor's degree in Materials Science, Chemical, Mechanical, or Manufacturing Engineering, or related field

7+ years in manufacturing/production operations, including team management experience

Strong material science foundation — able to connect powder properties and tape mechanics to process outcomes

Proven track record hiring, developing, and managing process/equipment engineers or technicians

Deep familiarity with manufacturing metrics (OEE, downtime) and a root-cause approach to problem-solving

Working knowledge of roll-to-roll processes — powder transformation, mixing, web handling

Strong influencing skills and experience representing your team's priorities to peer managers and engineering leadership

Pragmatic, curious, and comfortable with ambiguity as the organization scales

Where you'll work:

This role is based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV—an easy commute from the city of Pittsburgh, PA. This 550,000-square-foot facility is our hub for high-volume battery production and a leader in the new era of American energy manufacturing. Relocation assistance is available.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 
ABOUT THE JOB
 
The Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software and Algorithms is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and delivery of the Battlespace Awareness software for critical programs - ensuring it meets all technical, functional, and business requirements. Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines.  This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring. 
    • Establish clear objectives and deliverables for the software that align with program needs.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Maintain a deep understanding of underlying algorithms and software interfaces for battle management, threat prediction, tracking, and classification to ensure that the relevant services integrate effectively with the larger C2 system.
    • Stay updated on the latest techniques to work with subject matter experts in incorporating relevant innovations into the project plan.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement:
    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Release Management:
    • Oversee the planning and execution of the software release process, ensuring that deployment is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
    • Ensure that all software releases meet the defined quality standards before deployment.
  • Stakeholder Communication:

    • Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as needed to avoid bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies with the subject matter experts to minimize impact on the project timeline and deliverables.
    • Regularly review and update the risk management plan to reflect changes in the project landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work with other divisions and departments to ensure software supports the program priorities and meets all integration requirements.
    • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Battlespace Awareness business line and other stakeholders to promote a unified approach to program execution.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QAULIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.

Description

About the Team

AWS Global Energy is responsible for powering the world's most demanding cloud infrastructure. The team is organized across three verticals: Global Energy Strategy (GES), which leads the development of innovative commercial structures to meet capacity demand and AWS's carbon-free energy commitments; Power Generation Solutions (PGS), the single-threaded owner for AWS power generation and energy engineering — delivering capacity solutions aligned with AWS's availability, reliability, sustainability, and redundancy requirements and managing the production readiness lifecycle of AWS-owned or commissioned generation and storage assets; and Energy Portfolio Operations (EPO), which owns Amazon's global renewable PPA portfolio and AWS CFE supply agreements. Global Energy partners closely with regional data center planning and delivery, global sustainability, and broader Amazon business units on energy procurement and infrastructure needs.

About the Role

As a Senior Technical Program Manager on the PGS leadership team, you will report directly to the Head of Power Generation Solutions and serve as a strategic partner to PGS and Global Energy leadership. This is a dual-scope role: you will own technical program management for one of PGS's power programs, while also driving cross-cutting strategy, controllership, and operational mechanisms for PGS and the broader Global Energy organization.

You will work at the intersection of technical execution and business strategy, partnering with PGS engineering leads, Global Energy Principals, Energy Portfolio Operations, Finance, and senior AWS leadership to ensure our programs are on track, our organization is scaled appropriately, and our strategy is clear and actionable. You'll engage external partners, facilitate senior executive interactions, and serve as a trusted voice for PGS in cross-organizational forums.

This role is right for someone who thrives in ambiguity, thinks big, and can operate with equal fluency in a technical design review and a VP-level strategy session.

About You

You have a track record of delivering complex, ambiguous programs at scale — and doing it with the business acumen and executive presence to bring senior leaders along. You are data-driven but not data-bound; you know when to go deep and when to synthesize. You write clearly, speak directly, and earn trust quickly across organizational boundaries. You utilize AI regularly and have experience driving AI solutions at scale. 

You are energized by consequential work. AWS's power strategy is shaping how the world's infrastructure gets built — and this role sits at the center of it.

- Experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

Own technical program management for part of the AWS power program, including pipeline management, milestone tracking, senior leader engagement, and vendor coordination.

Drive continuous improvement in Global Energy's operating mechanisms — identifying gaps, proposing solutions, and leading implementation across teams.

Champion a high-performance team culture: model strong judgment, clear communication, and a bias for action.

The Power Generation Solutions team creates and delivers product and engineering solutions in for power and energy to help advance AWS’ mission to deliver world-leading cloud services. Our solutions are guided by four main principles; unlocking capacity growth, maintaining high infrastructure uptime, minimizing infrastructure costs, and advancing our net-zero carbon Climate Pledge. To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We also provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance.

title: Account Executive - Portfolio, Airforce
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/11/2026
Candidate must relocate or live in the listed territory

Westcoast

Meet the Team

You will join an elite, mission-driven sales organization within Cisco’s U.S. Federal Defense operation dedicated to empowering the United States Air Force and Space Force. As a Senior Account Executive supporting the US Air Force, you will play a critical role in enabling the mission readiness, secure digital modernization, and warfighter capabilities of our defense customer.

Serving as the Account Orchestrator, you will build and manage multi-year strategic relationships across designated Air Force commands and regional installations (such as Peterson SFB, Schriever SFB, Buckley SFB, Cheyenne Mountain, and the U.S. Air Force Academy). You will partner closely with Portfolio Solutions Engineers, Architecture Specialists, and executive defense leadership to drive sustainable, cross-portfolio growth and align Cisco's industry-leading technology with customer mission imperatives.

What You'll Do

Enterprise Account Orchestration & Deal Leadership: Orchestrate multi-faceted, highly complex deal cycles ($100K to $30M+) involving multiple stakeholders, defense commands, and program offices to drive impactful revenue growth and mission transformation.

Air Force Executive & Flag-Level Engagement: Engage with senior military and civilian leaders across the Air Force and Space Force, serving as the primary trusted advisor and commercial influencer in purchasing decisions.

Cross-Portfolio & Secure Networking Positioning: Drive sustainable cross-portfolio growth with deep expertise in core secure networking (enterprise switching, routing, wireless, and next-generation firewall), while collaborating with specialist teams on advanced security, cloud, and observability architectures.

Opportunity Qualification, Funnel Velocity & Forecasting: Build a robust sales pipeline through proactive opportunity prospecting; manage opportunities through all deal stages; maintain accurate representation in Cisco CRM; and analyze data to deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales commitments.

Consultative Deal Structuring & Negotiations: Lead commercial and contract negotiations with a consultative approach, expertly balancing competitive pricing, service level agreements, and multi-year federal contractual commitments (SEWP, GSA, DoD Enterprise Agreements).

Cross-Functional Teaming & Partner Teaming: Direct and align extended team resources (Portfolio SEs, TSAs, Services, RevOps, Legal, and Finance) and coordinate with defense ecosystem partners to deliver unified customer outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

5+ to 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise technology sales, strategic business development, or defense IT account management experience.

Demonstrated track record of successfully managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles ($1M+ to $10M+) and achieving annual sales quotas.

Solid foundational knowledge of enterprise networking and cybersecurity architectures, with specific focus on core secure networking (switching, routing, wireless, and firewall).

Proven ability to orchestrate cross-functional sales engineering, product specialist, legal, and commercial teams to navigate complex federal procurement cycles.

U.S. Citizenship required to comply with federal customer site access, background investigation, and security clearance requirements.

Ability to work in a hybrid, field-based model located in or near Denver, Colorado with travel to regional military installations and partner sites.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (with 5+ years of experience), Master’s degree (with 3+ years of experience), or equivalent practical experience in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

Extensive experience selling enterprise software, hardware, or cloud solutions directly to the U.S. Department of Defense (DoD), specifically the U.S. Air Force or U.S. Space Force.

Active U.S. Government Security Clearance (Secret or Top Secret / SCI).

Prior military service or experience working within defense acquisition commands (AFMC, AFLCMC, SSC, ACC, AMC, NORAD/USNORTHCOM).

Familiarity with DoD procurement contract vehicles, Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR/DFARS), and multi-year enterprise software agreements (DoD ESI, 2GIT, NASA SEWP).

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks.  Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

.75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;

1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and

Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

You will be responsible for balancing program execution, personnel management, contractual compliance, and business growth initiatives. Working closely with delivery, finance, recruiting, and business development teams, you will identify opportunities to expand existing accounts while maintaining operational excellence. You will also drive workforce development, resource planning, and performance management to ensure teams are equipped to meet evolving customer needs. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced leader with a strong background in federal programs, consulting, and cybersecurity to make a significant impact in a dynamic, remote-first environment.

Accountabilities:

Program and Delivery Management

Provide executive oversight of programs, projects, and task orders within the assigned customer portfolio.

Ensure all engagements are delivered on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contractual obligations and customer expectations.

Develop and monitor project plans, milestones, staffing requirements, dependencies, risks, and corrective actions.

Ensure contractual deliverables meet quality standards and are submitted accurately and on time.

Identify and escalate delivery, staffing, financial, and customer-related risks, driving issues through resolution.

Maintain strong customer relationships and serve as the primary escalation point for program delivery matters.

Capture program achievements, performance metrics, and success stories to support business development activities.

Personnel Management and Supervision

Provide first-line supervision, daily guidance, coaching, and performance management for assigned employees.

Establish clear performance expectations and align individual objectives with project, account, customer, and organizational goals.

Conduct regular one-on-one meetings to discuss performance, workload, professional development, engagement, and employee concerns.

Complete performance evaluations and provide constructive feedback, recognition, and development recommendations.

Identify opportunities for employee growth through training, certifications, professional development, and career advancement.

Address performance and conduct issues in coordination with Human Resources and delivery leadership.

Review and approve timecards, leave requests, and other personnel actions in accordance with company policies and contractual requirements.

Monitor employee utilization, workload, availability, and assignments to ensure effective resource deployment.

Support employee retention by proactively addressing engagement, career development, workload, and assignment concerns.

Participate in recruitment, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, promotions, resource assignments, and offboarding activities.

Maintain regular communication with remote employees and personnel working at customer locations to promote engagement and organizational alignment.

Coordinate staffing transitions and succession planning to maintain continuity of service delivery.

Account Growth and Business Development

Develop and execute strategic account growth plans for assigned customer groups.

Identify opportunities to expand existing programs through additional scopes of work, task orders, contract vehicles, and adjacent customer requirements.

Establish and monitor account-level targets for revenue, backlog, funded work, and workforce growth.

Collaborate with business development and capture teams to identify, qualify, shape, and pursue new business opportunities.

Maintain awareness of customer priorities, budgets, acquisition strategies, upcoming procurements, and competitive activity.

Translate anticipated growth opportunities into staffing and recruitment forecasts to ensure appropriate resources are available.

Customer Relationship Management

Serve as the senior point of contact and trusted advisor for key customer stakeholders.

Build and maintain relationships with government program leaders, contracting representatives, technical leaders, and other relevant stakeholders.

Conduct regular customer meetings and account reviews to assess performance, priorities, risks, and future opportunities.

Monitor customer satisfaction and proactively address concerns or service delivery issues.

Ensure delivery teams understand changing customer mission requirements and strategic priorities.

Balance customer expectations with responsibility for employee performance, professional development, and well-being.

Contract Compliance and Administration

Maintain oversight of contractual requirements, including scope, funding, performance periods, labor categories, staffing, deliverables, and reporting obligations.

Partner with Contracts and Finance teams to ensure compliance with contract terms and applicable government and organizational requirements.

Monitor contract funding, burn rates, ceilings, option periods, and key milestones.

Coordinate with Finance to ensure contract and project information within Unanet is accurate and regularly updated.

Ensure employees are assigned to authorized labor categories, work locations, and contractual responsibilities.

Promote compliance with customer requirements, security policies, timekeeping procedures, and internal standards.

Financial and Operational Management

Maintain accountability for the financial performance of the assigned account and its underlying programs.

Monitor revenue, labor utilization, project costs, profit margins, forecasts, and other financial performance indicators.

Maintain approximately 50% individual billable utilization through direct customer engagement or program delivery, balancing these responsibilities with portfolio leadership, personnel supervision, and business development.

Ensure accurate and timely employee and subcontractor timekeeping, with appropriate project and contract charge codes.

Review and approve personnel time records in accordance with established procedures.

Support accurate and timely customer invoicing and resolve billing discrepancies.

Work with Finance to maintain reliable revenue, resource, and staffing forecasts.

Identify financial and operational variances and implement appropriate corrective actions.

Performance Metrics and Reporting

Establish and maintain account-level performance scorecards.

Track key indicators, including revenue, margins, staffing, headcount, utilization, vacancies, deliverable status, customer satisfaction, invoice status, contract funding, burn rates, and growth pipeline.

Provide regular performance reports and financial forecasts to the Federal Services Director.

Maintain visibility into program risks, issues, opportunities, and corrective actions.

Deliver accurate and timely reporting to support leadership decisions and resource allocation.

Team and Organizational Leadership

Provide leadership and direction to Program Managers, Project Managers, technical leads, and other delivery professionals.

Build cohesive account teams with clear responsibilities across delivery, personnel management, customer engagement, and business development.

Maintain appropriate staffing levels and proactively address recruitment, retention, performance, and succession planning needs.

Partner with Recruiting and Human Resources to forecast workforce requirements and fill critical positions.

Promote accountability, communication, collaboration, and consistent delivery practices.

Mentor high-performing employees, delegate responsibilities, and develop future organizational leaders.

Foster a culture of customer service, professional development, operational excellence, and accountability.

Key Deliverables

Develop engagement delivery plans, staffing strategies, and project status reports.

Produce utilization and capacity forecasts aligned with active engagements and business development opportunities.

Prepare engagement financial reports covering budgets, gross margins, and profitability.

Develop Statements of Work (SOWs), change orders, and contract compliance documentation.

Create team development plans, performance reviews, and certification or upskilling roadmaps.

Contribute to delivery methodologies, templates, service catalogs, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Produce thought leadership materials, including white papers, blog posts, and technical accelerators, and represent the organization at relevant industry events.

Requirements:

Bachelor's or master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related discipline.

7–10+ years of relevant professional experience, including at least 3 years managing consulting or professional services teams and/or overseeing federal programs.

Demonstrated ability to balance direct, billable customer delivery responsibilities with portfolio leadership, personnel management, financial oversight, and business development.

In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity and information security domains, including cloud security, endpoint protection, risk management, and regulatory compliance.

Familiarity with established security frameworks and standards, such as NIST, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS.

Experience with project management methodologies, tools, and program delivery practices.

Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or PMP are strongly preferred.

Strong leadership and people management capabilities, with experience coaching, mentoring, and developing multidisciplinary teams.

Excellent communication, organizational, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills.

Strong financial and operational management abilities, including budgeting, forecasting, resource allocation, and performance monitoring.

Proven ability to manage multiple complex engagements while maintaining quality, contractual compliance, and customer satisfaction.

Ability to obtain and maintain a federal security clearance is required.

Experience building or scaling professional services or engineering teams is preferred.

Previous experience in fast-paced consulting environments is highly desirable.

High levels of integrity, accountability, adaptability, and strategic thinking.

Benefits:

Competitive compensation: Attractive salary package, paid twice monthly.

Annual performance bonus: Additional compensation tied to business segment results.

Healthcare coverage: Comprehensive medical insurance, with 100% of medical premiums covered by the employer.

Retirement savings: 401(k) plan with a 100% company match on the first 4% of eligible contributions.

Paid time off: Three weeks of PTO starting from the first year of employment.

Paid holidays: 11 paid holidays annually.

Family support: Paid maternity and paternity leave.

Remote work support: Monthly reimbursement for cell phone and home internet expenses.

Professional growth: Opportunities to contribute to technical initiatives, develop expertise, and support organizational innovation.

Description

Amazon Corporate Network Engineering is seeking a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager.

This is for the Corporate Network Engineering team. This TIPM will work closely with NDEs and SysDEs in the Corporate Network Engineering team to drive engineering projects, which are aimed towards delivering next-gen Engineering solutions for all Amazon Corporate Offices globally. This is Corporate Office Network Engineering team (not Data Center Network Engineering).

You will be responsible for defining business strategy, requirements and timelines along with working with multiple cross functional teams for networking projects in enterprise space. You will manage our cross-functional projects, which require working with all organizational levels and groups including Global IT, Corporate Infrastructure, Enterprise Network Engineering staff and internal project management teams, as well as external vendors. You will develop and manage project schedules, identify risks and clearly communicate them to project stakeholders, define problem solving and risk mitigation strategies, and facilitate conflict resolution through the full project cycle. A strong background in IT infrastructure, technology deployment or computer science is essential for your success in this position. You must have a proven track record of project completion that is on time and within budget. You must be able to command the intellectual respect of engineers as well as run extremely effective projects on compressed and timelines while dealing with ambiguity with grace and maturity.

The ideal candidate is a creative, demonstrated leader/manager with superior analytical abilities across a global networking base. This opportunity requires excellent technical, problem-solving, and communication skills. The candidate is not just a policy maker/spokesperson but drives to get things done. At the core of the position is planning and delivery. Ideal candidates have extensive experience with network build and delivery plans. Ideal candidates thrive in a rapidly advancing, changing, delivery-focused environments.

Key job responsibilities

- Manage multiple competing cross-functional projects/programs simultaneously

- Interact with engineers, technicians, project managers and senior management on a daily basis

- Run meetings, create and maintain timelines, and keep large, diverse groups informed of progress and obstacles

- Work with engineers to develop detail and creative solutions to complex problems, while keeping a watchful eye on timelines and costs

- Provide timely updates on project status to leadership and track progress of milestones.

- Should have a networking background, where you have worked on network engineering projects in the past.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a technology field

- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience

- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

- Experience in network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, routing, switching, HTTP)

- Knowledge of IP networking fundamentals such as BGP, OSPF and other R&S technologies

Preferred Qualifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

- certification in a relevant field (CCENT - Cisco Certified Entry Networking Technician, Network+, or CCNA - Cisco Certified Network Associate)

title: Senior Service Delivery Engineer
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, Germany

Overview

GitHub helps companies and organizations succeed by enabling them to build better software, together. We're looking for a Senior Service Delivery Engineer to support our Expert Services team in solving our customers' needs. The ideal candidate will have the aptitude and passion to become a master of GitHub's product capabilities and underlying technologies. We need a high performing engineering consultant to help our customers improve their software delivery. This person will solve challenges with many different technologies and work closely with our customers, as well as GitHub's internal departments


Responsibilities

Delivery Readiness

  • Monitor and evaluate performance and support readiness in delivery quality for customers and specific internal teams

  • Share technical expertise and contribute to the success of the team by providing coaching and role readiness training

  • Continue to evolve product knowledge to prepare for new product releases

 

Customer Delivery

  • Drive services pre-sales and scoping exercises to position GitHub value drivers to customers by focusing on customer outcomes

  • Enhance customer adoption of the GitHub platform while achieving targeted average billable utilization and Customer Satisfaction goals

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping solve increasingly complex technical issues

  • Provide advice to customers and partners during engagements

  • Manage client expectations, scope of work, and draft change orders as needed

  • Complete service delivery engagements within time and budget, while meeting customer expectations

  • Develop repeat business by positioning the value of future services delivery phases

 

Collaboration

  • Collaborate on cross-team and cross-product technical issues by working with resources from other groups

  • Help drive top organizational priorities by working with managers, engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders

  • Engage and collaborate with other GitHub groups to gain resolution for critical, complex issues

  • Advocate for product improvements based on customer feedback

  • Build communities to resolve customer and partner issues

 

Solutions Development

  • Understand customer goals and help create tailored solutions

  • Provide technical clarity regarding an array of technologies

  • Help customers make informed decisions by weighing critical technical solutions

  • Create high-quality, reusable solutions for customers

  • Build solutions such as migrating source code from legacy systems, creating CI/CD pipelines, or automating infrastructure provisioning


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR equivalent experience

  • 1+ year(s) experience leading customer projects

  • Experience in Software Development or DevOps

  • In-depth knowledge of the Git version control system

Preferred Qualifications

  • 9+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 7+ years experience

    • OR Master's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience

  • 3+ years experience leading customer projects

  • 3+ years experience in technical consulting

  • Familiarity with the GitHub platform and associated workflows or familiarity with legacy version control systems (SVN, CVS, ClearCase, AccuRev, etc.)

  • Strong experience with AI-assisted coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate and improve software development workflows

  • Business level proficiency in German, Dutch, French or Spanish 

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

Equal Employment Opportunity

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

title: Senior Solutions Architect (German speaking)
description:
At Sanity.io, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like PUMA, Carhartt WIP, Anthropic, Just Eat Takeaway, Spotify, HiPP, and Mercedes-AMG are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

Your team ensures that enterprise customers are successful and happy using Sanity. This means working closely with technical leaders at our customers to align their strategic goals with implementation details; facilitating brainstorming sessions between editors, designers, and developers; and helping developers make decisions for their unique business needs.

In this role, you will take ownership of your customer relationships and drive both internal and external conversations. You'll also have the opportunity to learn more and develop expertise on the people's side of technology.

What you would do:

  • Lead onboarding workshops that are customized to each customer’s needs and background.

  • Proactively develop relationships with technical and product stakeholders at our customers.

  • Meet regularly with technical customers to demonstrate how new features work for the customer’s specific needs, answer their questions, and help them plan their Sanity implementation.

  • Work with account managers to develop expansion opportunities at existing customers

  • Support the new account sales cycle through technical workshops and proof of concept development

  • Create and share examples to help customers understand concepts and implement more quickly

  • Develop and maintain guides and learning modules to address common topics

  • Develop and maintain plugins for common integrations and implementation patterns

  • Represent clients’ requests and requirements to the internal product team

  • Work with Support Engineering to work through customer challenges and unblock specific scenarios

  • Support marketing and product research teams to connect with relevant customers and plan events and webinars


About you:

  • Based in Germany or the United Kingdom

  • You're fluent in both German and English

  • 3-5 years of experience in a software development role

  • Advanced experience with at least one of the following frameworks: React, Vue, Angular, Astro

  • Familiar with backend architecture and SaaS platform integrations

  • Experience with one of the following:

    • Implementing headless CMS

    • Implementing headless e-commerce

    • As a Solution Engineer or Solution Architect at a developer-focused SaaS

  • Outstanding communication skills, both verbally and in writing

  • Proven experience developing solutions with customers

  • Problem-solving skills with a results-oriented mindset

  • Exceptional organizational and time management skills

  • Structured with a strong attention to details

  • Bonus: experience in a B2B customer-facing role, such as consulting or account management

  • Bonus: you have used Sanity in production

Not sure you’re exactly what we’re looking for in this role? Apply anyway!


What we can offer:

  • A highly-skilled, inspiring, and supportive team

  • Positive, flexible, and trust-based work environment that encourages long-term professional and personal growth

  • A global, multi-culturally diverse group of colleagues and customers

  • Comprehensive health plans and perks

  • A healthy work-life balance that accommodates individual and family needs

  • Competitive salary and stock options program

Who we are:

Sanity.io is a modern, flexible content operating system that replaces rigid legacy content management systems. One of our big differentiators is treating content as data so that it can be stored in a single source of truth, but seamlessly adapted and personalized for any channel without extra effort. Forward-thinking companies choose Sanity because they can create tailored content authoring experiences, customized workflows, and content models that reflect their business.

Sanity recently raised a $85m Series C led by GP Bullhound and is also backed by leading investors like ICONIQ Growth, Threshold Ventures, Heavybit and Shopify, as well as founders of companies like Vercel, WPEngine, Twitter, Mux, Netlify and Heroku. This funding round has put Sanity in a strong position for accelerated growth in the coming years.

You can only build a great company with a great culture. Sanity is a 300+ person company with highly committed and ambitious people. We are pioneers, we exist for our customers, we are hel ved, and we love type two fun! Read more about our values here!

Sanity.io pledges to be an organization that reflects the globally diverse audience that our product serves. We believe that in addition to hiring the best talent, a diversity of perspectives, ideas, and cultures leads to the creation of better products and services. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

description:
At Sanity.io, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like PUMA, Carhartt WIP, Anthropic, Just Eat Takeaway, Spotify, HiPP, and Mercedes AMG are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

 

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Sanity, you'll own the full sales cycle, from identifying the right prospects to closing deals with some of Europe's most ambitious companies. You'll work closely with SEs, SDRs, and marketing to build genuine relationships with enterprise customers and help them understand the real business value of structured content. It's a role with real autonomy, clear progression, and strong earning potential at a company that just raised $85M and is scaling fast.

 

What you would do

  • Take warm opportunities from our SDR and Marketing teams and run with them, your job is to close, not to chase cold leads all day

  • Get under the skin of every prospect: understand their real business challenges and show them exactly how Sanity solves them

  • Pitch, negotiate, and close enterprise deals and get well rewarded when you do

  • Map organisations from the inside out, building relationships across teams from developers to the C-suite

  • Work through procurement and contracts without losing your mind (we'll help)

  • Be the voice of the customer internally - your feedback shapes product, messaging, and strategy

  • Keep your pipeline tight: accurate forecasting, clean Salesforce data, and deal reviews that actually reflect reality


About you

  • You're based in Germany and fluent in both German and English - You can close a deal in either language without breaking a sweat

  • You've sold a complex SaaS product before and you know how to navigate technical buyers, marketing leaders, and enterprise procurement all at once

  • You have experience selling into large enterprises and are comfortable managing big, multi-stakeholder deals from first call to signed contract

  • You're genuinely curious, about technology, about your customers' businesses, and about finding smarter ways to sell

  • You pick up new products quickly and can translate complexity into a compelling story

  • You're honest, high-integrity, and the kind of person colleagues actually enjoy working with

  • You thrive when things move fast and you're not waiting around for someone to tell you what to do

 

What we can offer

  • A highly-skilled, inspiring, and supportive team

  • Positive, flexible, and trust-based work environment that encourages long-term professional and personal growth

  • A global, multi-culturally diverse group of colleagues and customers

  • Comprehensive health plans and perks

  • A healthy work-life balance that accommodates individual and family needs

  • Competitive location-based salary and stock options program

 

Who we are

Sanity.io is a modern, flexible content operating system that replaces rigid legacy content management systems. One of our big differentiators is treating content as data so that it can be stored in a single source of truth, but seamlessly adapted and personalized for any channel without extra effort. Forward-thinking companies choose Sanity because they can create tailored content authoring experiences, customized workflows, and content models that reflect their business.

Sanity recently raised a $85m Series C led by GP Bullhound and is also backed by leading investors like ICONIQ Growth, Threshold Ventures, Heavybit and Shopify, as well as founders of companies like Vercel, WPEngine, Twitter, Mux, Netlify and Heroku. This funding round has put Sanity in a strong position for accelerated growth in the coming years.

You can only build a great company with a great culture. Sanity is a 300+ person company with highly committed and ambitious people. We are pioneers, we exist for our customers, we are hel ved, and we love type two fun! Read more about our values here!

 

Sanity.io pledges to be an organization that reflects the globally diverse audience that our product serves. We believe that in addition to hiring the best talent, a diversity of perspectives, ideas, and cultures leads to the creation of better products and services. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

Identify and implement process improvements that enhance NSO execution efficiency, predictability, and customer delivery performance.

Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization skills.

Ability to manage multiple highly customized projects simultaneously in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Knowledge of manufacturing operations, change management, configuration management, and production planning processes.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to make data-driven decisions.

Yes, 10% of the Time

No

Responsibilities

Strategy & Prioritization

Partner closely with the stakeholders and UX design team to shape and translate product vision into executable roadmaps for the TMS and FO product lines.

Conduct market research and competitive analysis across the F&B tech landscape (reservation platforms, POS ecosystems, food ordering, channel managers) to provide product recommendations.

Evaluate product and integration opportunities by balancing merchant value, patron experience, partner impact, engineering effort, and operational complexity.

Continuously monitor product and partner metrics (e.g. partner-driven bookings, seated conversion, no-show rate) and provide insights to refine priorities and roadmap execution.

Program Management

Lead cross-functional programs from planning through execution across the TMS and FO product surfaces, including different interfaces for both restaurants and patrons, and premium add-on features.

Coordinate closely with Engineering, Design, QA, CSM/BD, Marketing, Operations, and other stakeholders to align priorities and execution.

Manage Product Backlog, Release Planning, Sprint Planning, and Scrum execution.

Identify project risks, resolve blockers proactively, and drive teams toward successful delivery, including launch readiness such as internal playbooks and training.

Global Partner Integration

Own the end-to-end partner integration lifecycle: scoping and scenario design, API documentation and testing setup, kickoff, development support, E2E testing, launch, and post-launch operations.

Manage integrations across partner types — booking platforms, POS systems, membership systems, malls and hospitality groups, and regional restaurant groups.

Serve as the primary technical counterpart for global partners across regions and time zones, running kickoff meetings, joint testing, and ongoing technical communication.

Define integration scenarios, acceptance criteria, and success metrics; keep integration projects transparent and on track for internal and external stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management & F&B Insights

Manage intensive, ongoing communication across internal stakeholders (leadership, Engineering, Design, QA, Go to Market teams with daily interaction, Marketing) and external stakeholders (partners and key merchant accounts) with often-competing priorities.

Develop a deep understanding of restaurant front-of-house operations: reservations as inventory management and capacity planning, reservations as a key patron touchpoint, table management, queuing, no-show and revenue assurance/deposit policies, and online food ordering workflows — and represent the merchant's voices in product decisions.

Translate merchant and partner feedback into clear pain point statements and roadmap inputs.

Support multinational delivery with customers in seven highly differentiated markets, including localization and market-specific requirements across regions such as TW, HK, JP, SEA, and ANZ.

 

Requirements

Required

5+ years of Technical Product Management, Technical Program Management, or related experience.

Experience building B2B or B2B2C SaaS software ; vertical SaaS for F&B, restaurants, or hospitality is a strong plus.

Deep F&B industry knowledge, especially restaurant front-of-house operations: reservation and table management, queuing, deposits/no-show handling, POS, or food ordering.

Hands-on experience with adding new third-party integrations And expanding upon existing third-party Integrations — REST APIs, Webhooks, API key/staging environment management, data licensing compliance automation, and end-to-end testing with external partner engineering teams.

Excellent stakeholder management skills, with a track record of driving alignment across executives, cross-functional teams, and external partners.

Ability to work closely with Engineering to evaluate technical feasibility, development effort, and resource planning.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

Excellent cross-functional communication and program management skills; able to work in English with global partners.

 

Preferred

Experience working directly with engineers designers in one or more of the following areas is highly preferred:

Online payment systems, including payment gateways (e.g. Stripe, TapPay), digital wallets (Apple Pay, AliPay, WeChat Pay), deposits/prepayment flows, or subscription billing.

Omnichannel messaging or Omnichannel CRM systems (e.g. Intercom, Twilio Flex, Zendesk, etc)

Global Distribution Systems (GDS) used by airlines or hotels to create and manage priced booking inventory that is published to OTA services (e.g. Amadeus, Travelport, Sabre, or Siteminder, Opera, Cendyn, Shiji, etc)

Booking channel integrations, such as Reserve with Google, channel managers, or OTA/booking platform ecosystems.

POS or hospitality tech ecosystems, including KDS, kiosk, or in-store hardware-adjacent products.

Multi-market product delivery, including multi-language support and market-specific compliance or operational requirements.

Experience working with Product Analytics and data-driven prioritization.

Join Quantum-Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real-world operations. As Senior Payload Integration Engineer, you will own the payload integration across our UGV platforms: the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration of a wide range of mission payloads into our own Mandrill UGV and partner vehicle platforms. Your goal is a payload-agnostic platform with scalable, reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions, so we can adapt quickly to evolving mission needs without redesigning the vehicle for every new configuration. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You drive the integration architecture end to end, from interface definition through bring-up and commissioning to the point where the complete E/E system is proven to work on the vehicle. You will work at the intersection of vehicle hardware, autonomy and MOSAIC orchestration software, mechanical engineering, suppliers, and manufacturing. 


What is your Day to Day Mission:

Payload Integration Architecture and Ownership

  • Define and own the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration concept for various payloads across our UGV platforms, ensuring scalable and reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions. 

  • Design, specify, and validate payload interfaces: power supply, signal routing, communication interfaces, connectors, mounting concepts, cooling, grounding and shielding, and serviceability. 

  • Enable a payload-flexible vehicle platform that supports a wide range of customer-specific payloads (power profiles, environmental conditions, data interfaces) without major redesigns for every new configuration. 

  • Electrical, Electronic and mechanical Integration

  • Integrate payloads into the vehicle power, network, compute, and control architectures: schematics, harnessing, connectors, fusing, diagnostics, and interface documentation. 

  • Work with vehicle communication buses (CAN, automotive Ethernet) to bring payload data and control interfaces cleanly into the vehicle architecture. 

  • Own the health of the complete E/E system: systematic cross-domain troubleshooting across payload, harness, power, compute, and software. 

  • Drive payload mounting together with internal vehicle teams and external suppliers: brackets, packaging, accessibility, vibration robustness, environmental protection, maintainability, and manufacturability. 

Bring-up, Commissioning and Validation

  • Plan and execute payload bring-up and commissioning on vehicle prototypes and demonstrators: mechanical fitment, electrical integration, software provisioning (flashing, configuration, diagnostics), troubleshooting, and validation up to full system commissioning where the complete E/E system is proven to work. 

  • Define acceptance criteria, build and run system-level test setups, automate recurring integration and regression tests with scripts and test tooling, and support field testing. 

  • Translate integration findings into design improvements for vehicle and payload interfaces, and feed validated test workflows into our CI and test infrastructure together with the HW integration and SW Factory teams. 

  • Work directly with payload suppliers: clarify requirements, review technical documentation, align interface specifications, and drive issue resolution. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Documentation 

  • Create clear interface control documents, integration guides, test reports, lessons learned, and reusable standards for future payload integrations. 

  • Actively support build-ups, rework, payload installation, and vehicle-level commissioning in the workshop during prototype and customer-specific integration phases. 



What you bring to the team:

  • Engineering degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, vehicle systems, or a comparable technical field. 

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in field robotics, vehicle, or mechatronic system integration; you have brought complex E/E systems to life on real vehicles or machines. 

  • Strong E/E integration expertise: power distribution, signal interfaces, connectors, wiring harnesses, grounding, shielding, diagnostics, and vehicle-level troubleshooting. 

  • Hands-on experience with vehicle communication buses (CAN, ideally CAN-FD or automotive Ethernet), including reading and debugging bus traffic during integration. 

  • Solid mechanical integration understanding: mounting concepts, packaging, tolerances, vibration, environmental robustness, accessibility, and serviceability. 

  • Practical software skills for integration work: Linux, scripting (e.g. Python or Bash), software provisioning and configuration of embedded devices, and issue tracking tools. You are comfortable automating recurring integration tests. 

  • Experience defining and running validation setups from bench and rig level up to vehicle-level testing, with a quality-first mindset and the discipline to design reliable, repeatable test setups. 

  • Strong integration mindset: systematic in debugging, structured in documentation, and able to turn unclear payload requirements into practical engineering solutions. 

  • Hands-on mentality: comfortable working directly on vehicles, prototypes, harnesses, brackets, and payload installations in the workshop. 

  • Strong communication skills across engineering teams, suppliers, procurement, and program stakeholders. 

  • Fluent in German and English. 

  • High ownership, pragmatic, and thriving in a fast-paced environment. 

Your Benefits: 

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Senior Talent Partner has moved into the Head of People and Talent role, so we're looking for someone to take over day-to-day hiring processes for the whole company. We're growing across every team, and you'll be the person who makes sure each of them gets great people when they need them.

This is a full-cycle role first. You'll own searches end to end, from shaping the brief with a hiring manager to closing the offer. Roughly half your roles will be in engineering and half in other functions, so one week you're calibrating an engineering loop and the next you're hiring for sales or operations. That includes the less glamorous parts, like a small distributed team and meetings that stretch into your evening so we can work with the US.

Full-cycle recruiting

  • Running multiple searches at once across engineering and non-engineering teams, from intake to accepted offer, prioritised by urgency

title: (Senior) Deployment Strategist
description:
You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants.

Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We serve manufacturers from Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, and are backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Palantir, McKinsey, Meta, Google, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity.

WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT?

You will take a signed logo and turn them into a flagship reference. That means getting onto the shopfloor fast, understanding what drives their KPIs, and deploying Ethon's agentic workflows where the impact is highest. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. Once the plant manager is convinced, you get to the COO. This is what you'll do:

  • Own the deployment: You're the person who makes sure go-live happens on time and the customer's team knows how to use it. You handle the onboarding, the training, and the change management that gets a new platform embedded into daily operations.

  • Turn shopfloor problems into business cases: An operator tells you yield drops on line 3 every Tuesday night. You figure out why, quantify what it costs, and build the case for the next deployment. You're as comfortable talking to a process engineer as you are presenting to a VP of Operations.

  • Drive expansion: You know which teams in the account haven't seen Ethon yet, which problems are still unsolved, and what it takes to get the next use case signed.

  • Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor.

  • Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better.

  • Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING?

The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck.

  • You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case

  • You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor

  • You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors

  • You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools

  • You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it

  • You're open to travel 30-50% of the time

This is how we'll set you up in your first six months:

  • Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You shadow live accounts, learn the platform end-to-end, and expand your understanding of how manufacturers think. You start working on your first account.

  • Months 3-4: You own delivery for one or more accounts, with support from the team.

  • Months 5-6: Full ownership of one or more customers. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion.

Great fits tend to come from backgrounds like:

  • Deployment, implementation, or customer success at high-growth industrial tech companies (e.g., Palantir, c3ai, Rockwell, Siemens Digital Industries) where you owned outcomes

  • Top-tier consulting, ready to stop writing recommendations and start executing them

  • Digital transformation or operational excellence roles inside manufacturing companies, where things were moving too slowly for you

  • Manufacturing or process engineering, where you've lived the problems Ethon solves, you know what a plant manager actually cares about, and customers trust you the moment you walk onto their floor

  • A technical degree in chemical, mechanical, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field

Bonus:

  • Experience with MES, ERP, Historian, or quality systems in manufacturing environments

  • Fluency in German, French, or another European language

WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU?

We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here outgrow their title fast.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Performance-based career & growth paths

  • On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules

  • Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success

  • Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation

  • Flexible parental leave

  • Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Senior Partner Account Executive to launch, scale, and optimise partnerships across our ecosystem with a focus on insurance carriers and brokers. Samsara's telematics and dashcam technology already help thousands of customers improve safety and reduce risk - this role will accelerate those benefits by developing high-impact partnerships that drive mutual growth.

You will be the face of Samsara to insurance executives, building scalable programmes that directly influence customer acquisition, retention, and loss cost improvement. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, are motivated by measurable business impact, and enjoy turning ideas into reality, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

  • Own and grow our relationships with insurance carriers, brokers and MGAs in the UK
  • Design and run partner programmes that drive customer acquisition, retention and loss-cost improvement - and the Samsara revenue that comes with them
  • Map accounts with partners, pick joint targets and bring Samsara sales into the deals
  • Build the playbook: how we qualify, onboard and scale insurance partnerships

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact - helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your partners are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live. Samsara's top employees do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You want to develop the playbook, not just follow one: Our partner ecosystem is young. You'll define how we take partners to value - from first conversation to joint customers - and build the model that lets those partnerships deliver maximum value for Samsara at scale.

  • You build genuine relationships with your partners and our customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
